```{r}
#--- Installing packages ---#
install.packages("worldfootballR")
```

```{r}
#--- Library funstuff ---#
library(tidyverse)
library(worldfootballR)
```

```{r}
seasons <- c(2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021)

save_path <- save_path <- "C:/Users/jonty/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Group-sprint-0-Sports-Prediction/data/premier_league_match_result_data"

dir.create(save_path, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (season in seasons) {
  
  match_result_data <- load_match_results(
    season_end_year = season,
    country = "ENG",
    gender = "M",
    tier = "1st"
  )
  
    write.csv(
    match_result_data,
    file.path(
      save_path,
      paste0(
        "premier_league_",
        season - 1,
        "-",
        substr(season, 3, 4),
        "_match_result_data.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```
